'''Yi Shen''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Eidolon Hold''' in the '''Einheriar''' system of the [[Colonia]] region. He specialises in stealth, low-light operations, and precision weapon damage.<ref name="inara-yi">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/36/ Yi Shen — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="edwiki-yi">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Yi_Shen Yi Shen], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

Frontier introduced Yi with the four Colonia Odyssey Engineers and identifies them as providers of suit and personal-equipment modifications for commanders working on low-atmosphere worlds.<ref name="frontier-colonia">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/galnet/the-view-from-colonia The View from Colonia], Frontier Developments, 29 October 2021. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

Yi's workshop is at '''Eidolon Hold''', a surface Engineer base on '''Einheriar 1''' in the '''Einheriar''' system. The body is approximately 163 light-seconds from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-eidolon">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/427832/ Eidolon Hold — Station], INARA. Accessed 12 September 2026.</ref>

The workshop is in the Colonia region, roughly 22,000 light-years from Sol. No system permit is required.

== Discovery and access ==

Yi is reached through the three independently accessible Colonia Odyssey Engineers. Complete each of their referral tasks:<ref name="inara-yi" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Engineer
! Referral task
|-
| [[Baltanos]]
| Provide 10 Faction Associates Data.
|-
| [[Eleanor Bresa]]
| Provide 10 Digital Designs Data.
|-
| [[Rosa Dayette]]
| Provide 10 Manufacturing Instructions Data.
|}

The tasks are independent and may be completed in any order. Completing all three discovers Yi and grants access to his workshop; there is no additional commodity delivery, sales target, or reputation requirement at Eidolon Hold.<ref name="inara-yi" />

Station services may not appear immediately after access is granted. If necessary, return to the main menu and re-enter the game.<ref name="inara-yi" />

== Services ==

Yi installs two suit modifications and two handheld-weapon modifications.<ref name="inara-yi" />

=== Suit modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Night Vision
| Adds a low-light viewing mode to the suit.
|-
| Quieter Footsteps
| Reduces the distance from which footsteps can be heard.
|}

=== Weapon modifications ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Function
|-
| Audio Masking
| Reduces a weapon's simulated sound in unpressurised environments.
|-
| Headshot Damage
| Increases damage inflicted by headshots.
|}

{{Field note|Yi combines Night Vision and Quieter Footsteps on one workshop roster, making him particularly useful for a stealth-oriented suit. Audio Masking applies in unpressurised environments; Noise Suppressor is the related firearm modification for pressurised interiors.}}

Suit and handheld-weapon modifications are permanent once installed. The equipment must have an unused modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits are paid at the workshop. See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for equipment grades, modification slots, material handling, and the installation process.

== Reputation and progression ==

Odyssey Engineers do not use the Grade 1–5 workshop-reputation system used by ship Engineers. Once Yi is unlocked, his available modifications can be installed immediately when the equipment and material requirements are met.

Yi does not provide a direct referral to another Engineer.<ref name="inara-yi" />
